provenance: Expected outcomes written by Claude (an AI assistant) from the specification. Reviewed with AI assistance (Claude) on 2026-10-17; the changes recorded in each case's goldHistory were approved by Sameer. Not an independent human review, and not verified against any real-world truth.
goldLabel: scored against gold written by Claude; reviewed with AI assistance (Claude); final decisions approved by Sameer (not an independent human review)

versionHistory.summary: Review applied: E-06 gains a task; approval reason codes made consistent with the approval policy for E-01, E-02, E-03, E-06 and E-07. E-05 and E-09 were reviewed and left unchanged. approvalReasonCodes means: these codes must be among those the policy produced (extra codes, such as confidence_not_high in a real run, are allowed).

note: DECIDE evaluation cases. Scoped to DECIDE.
Expectations come from the specification's stated outcomes, not from what the rules happen to produce.
AUTONOMY: these cases run at `assisted`, because the specification describes E-05 and E-09 as auto-executing
at tier 0 — which is what `assisted` means. The shipped default is `manual` (the specification: 'the default
for a new client'), under which every one of these would require approval. Both behaviours are
correct; this dataset measures the one the specification documents.
E-04, E-08 and E-10 are absent on purpose: UNDERSTAND and RESOLVE hold them at needs_review, so DECIDE never
runs on them. An entry here would assert behaviour that cannot occur.
